title: Tabaxkati Tower yi
intro: Bu yàgg, amoon na civilisasioŋ bu am doole bu feeñ, ñu ràññee ko ci tabax bu yéeme ak dooleem ju rëy. Mbootaay boobu ñu ngi ko jox ay moomeel yu bari ak dooley yaram, waaye ñu tànn yoonu xeex bataaxal bi Yàlla yónnee leen ngir jiite leen. Seen jaar-jaar nekk na njàngale mu am solo ci taarixu taarix, di firndeel loraange yi ci bañ dëgg.
clues: Dañu nu jox doole ak yaram wu rëy, nu wuute ak yeneen nit ñi ci sunu jamono.
Xamoon nañu nu ci tabax kër yu rëy ak ponk yu kawe ci barab bu kawe, yaakaar ni dina ñu dundu ba fàww.
Amna ab ndaw bu jóge ci nun, mu artu nu, di nu woo ci jaamu Yàlla rekk, bàyyi sunu xërëm yi.
Nu laaj sunu ndaw ak réy-réew, nu laaj ndax dañu ñëw ci nun ngir fexe nu jaamu Yàlla rek, bàyyi li sunuy maam jaamu.
Sunu réew bariwoon na ay jardin, ay puur, ak ay tool yu bari ay doom, waaye danu jàpp ni sunu naataange mingi aju ci sunu doole, te du ci sunu Boroom.
Ndax sunu ñàkka gëm ak ñaawal, ngelaw lu metti, luy tàng guddi ak bëccëg, moo nu mujjee yàq.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
